author: Inside Edition
description: Meghan Markle's estranged father is back in jail after allegations that he cut his ankle monitoring bracelet. Thomas Markle had been wearing the monitoring device as a condition of his release on bail, following his arrest last week. Meanwhile, his daughter ignored questions from reporters as she arrived with Prince Harry at the European Parliament in Brussels. Both she and Harry were scheduled to speak about the online safety of children.
title: Thomas Markle Allegedly Cut Off Ankle Monitor

author: Inside Edition
description: Video shows a house was completely engulfed in flames. Authorities say there were multiple e-bikes and scooters charging on the same outlet, which started to smoke before exploding. The homeowner is former Miss Teen USA contestant Kari Ann Peniche. Lithium-ion batteries catching fire is a growing problem, according to authorities. Electrical engineer Brad Davis and his team showed us what could happen if a lithium battery is deliberately over-charged.
title: Miss Teen USA Contestant's House Catches Fire From Lithium-Ion Battery

author: Inside Edition
description: Newly released bodycam footage shows police rushing to an apartment building where a student had just bounced out of an eighth-floor window. Kristin Sargent was dancing in her apartment when she jumped on a couch and went out the window. The accident happened at an apartment building in Athens, Georgia, where Sargent is a finance and marketing senior at the University of Georgia. It is believed her life was saved because she landed on a cushioned sofa.
title: Bodycam Video Shows Aftermath Of Georgia College Student Falling Out Of Window

author: Inside Edition
description: When President Trump recently made a surprise phone call to a late night call-in show on CSPAN, a mystery woman could be heard giggling in the background. Social media is buzzing with speculation over who the mystery giggler is. In a statement to Inside Edition, the White House said the laugh was leftover audio from a previous caller who had not disconnected yet. Meanwhile, it looks like the president has lost a reliable Republican vote on Capitol Hill.
title: Who Is The Mystery Giggler In President's Trump Phone Call?

author: Inside Edition
description: Officials at a California airport say a Cessna flipped over after getting hit by the jet blast of a departing plane. It happened at John Wayne Airport in Orange County. A statement from the Flight Center said the airport is undergoing major reconstruction and general aircraft are being adversely affected by it. In this case, it seems the Cessna was heading toward a taxiway when the airline jet was given the go ahead to take off. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cessna Flips Upside Down After Getting Caught In Another Plane's Jet Blast

author: Inside Edition
description: A Tennessee woman wanted an adrenaline rush to mark a milestone. Miss Yvonne Stults got her birthday wish when her senior home and her daughter brought her to the Nashville Zoo so she could cross off another bucket list adventure: ziplining. Her daughter tells WTVF that Yvonne went skiing for her 90th birthday, and that10 years later, she still hasn't lost her adventurous spirit. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 100 Year-Old Woman Celebrates Birthday By Ziplining

author: Inside Edition
description: Tammy Bishop from South Dakota is desperately trying to find the wedding ring her husband, Will, lost on their wedding day in Las Vegas. Will noticed the ring was gone as they were out celebrating tying the knot. They backtracked their steps, but weren't able to find the piece of jewelry. The loss of the ring is especially hard because immediately after they got home from their wedding trip, Will suddenly died. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more. To donate to Tammy's GoFundMe, visit https://www.gofundme.com/f/empowering-tammy-your-support-builds-her-strength
title: Woman Wants Ring Late Husband Lost On Wedding Day

author: Inside Edition
description: The National Transportation Safety Board says it found the voice recorder from the Learjet60 that crashed in Florida on November 1st. Officials posted photos to social media stating the recorder was found at the site of initial impact. It will be evaluated at the Board’s laboratory in Washington, D.C. The flight originated in Austin, Texas and was en route to The Bahamas when a pilot issued a mayday call. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Learjet Black Box Recorder Found At Crash Site In Florida
